title: ilye(6): spec/03-adaptation.md — normative Rule 255 RX byte-preserving paragraph
description: Slice 6 of project-LICHEN-worker6-ilye. Add the DECIDED normative paragraph to the Rule 255 section of spec/03-adaptation.md: Rule 255 decode MUST verify framing and integrity (header structure, next-header chain, UDP checksum over the addresses present) and MUST be byte-preserving on success; endpoint address policy (loopback, IPv4-mapped, unspecified, multicast source, destination scope) MUST NOT be applied at decode — it applies at packet origination and at the forwarding decision; integrity/structural failures report before endpoint-shape opinions. Self-contained; no code dependency; landable first.
